business_problem: Liepin wanted to push recruitment workflows toward more precise, AI-native operations, but keyword screening, manual candidate search, and slow response cycles were limiting matching quality and user experience. The platform needed a way to automate JD creation, job posting, talent matching, and interview summarization without reducing the specificity required by its recruiter-centered BHC model.
solution_summary: Liepin worked with Alibaba Cloud Bailian and Qwen models to insert large-model reasoning into multiple steps of the recruitment chain instead of only adding a chatbot on top of search. The company uses Bailian-based prompt customization to generate and refine job descriptions, then reuses the same model layer in intelligent job posting, person-to-position matching, interview support, and summarization workflows. Because the platform serves enterprises, headhunters, and job seekers in one loop, the model outputs are designed to shorten matching time while keeping recommendations and communications more targeted than simple keyword filters allow. In practice, JD generation, matching, and interview summarization run as linked services on one LLM foundation rather than disconnected tools, which helps Liepin upgrade the recruitment process with shared prompts and model behavior while improving response quality for both recruiters and candidates.

solution_components.name: Bailian
solution_components.role: Acts as the large-model application platform that coordinates Liepin's recruitment AI workflows.

solution_components.name: Qwen models
solution_components.role: Provide the language understanding and generation used across JD creation, matching, and interview workflows.

solution_components.name: prompt optimization workflow
solution_components.role: Customizes prompts so model behavior fits Liepin's recruitment-specific tasks and output quality needs.

solution_components.name: intelligent job-posting workflow
solution_components.role: Uses the model layer to generate and improve job descriptions and related posting content.

solution_components.name: candidate-matching service
solution_components.role: Applies the model stack to person-to-position matching so recruiters can find stronger candidates faster.

solution_components.name: interview summarization service
solution_components.role: Produces AI-assisted interview summaries to reduce repetitive recruiting work.

data_flow: Recruiter requirements enter the Bailian application layer, where prompt-optimized Qwen models generate or refine job descriptions, then reuse the same context for intelligent posting, person-to-position matching, and interview-summary generation. Those outputs are returned to recruiters and platform users as part of one connected recruitment workflow.
business_outcome: Liepin turned large models into a recruitment-operations layer rather than a demo feature. The deployment reduces repetitive screening and drafting work, speeds person-to-position matching, lowers errors from subjective manual filtering, and improves candidate experience by shortening response times across JD creation, matching, and interview-summary workflows.
architecture_clues: One LLM foundation is reused across JD generation, intelligent job posting, candidate matching, and interview summaries.
Prompt optimization is part of the production design so model behavior fits recruitment-specific tasks.
The system is built around Liepin's BHC loop for enterprises, headhunters, and candidates rather than a simple two-sided marketplace.
